meta.name: The Saint: TV Series & Movies Archive
meta.description:
Archive of the tv series and movies featuring the popular character The Saint by Leslie Charteris.

This archive contains the following movies:
Movies:
-The Saint (1997)-The Saint (2017)
TV Series-The Saint (1962-1969) - 6 seasons
-Return of the Saint (1978-1979) - 1 season

Uploaded for archival purposes. I will be slowly uploading this archive as I live in a third world country and my internet is garbage. So if something is missing wait a bit.
UPDATES:

10/10/2022: Finally added Return of the Saint. It took no joke like 6 hours to upload so I'm dreading the 6 Seasons of The Saint. Alas, the show must go on! 

21/10/22: It took like 2 days and a lot of my bandwith but the complete series of The Saint has been uploaded! 

It is done AFAIK. If anything is missing please do send me a message.
Cheers and have fun!
